# Feature Delivery solution design

Use only the validated feature brief, codebase analysis, and trusted logical-slot names. Trace the decision and alternatives to every stable acceptance-criterion ID.

Do not emit or choose repository paths, control fields, commands, credentials, retries, or effects. Escalate any expansion beyond the accepted frame.
